PLAN "Bodyweight Strength Foundation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
GOAL primary strength
name "Build foundational strength using bodyweight and minimal equipment"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary muscle
name "Develop muscle endurance and control"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1: Movement Mastery" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 40m "Upper body push and pull"
WARMUP
arm_circles 10 reps
jog_in_place 2m
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
push_up 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
pull_up 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
scapular_retraction 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
chest_stretch 30 seconds
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
lat_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower body and core"
WARMUP
leg_swings 10 reps each leg
hip_circles 10 reps each direction
jog_in_place 2m
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
bodyweight_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
plank 3x20..30 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
quad_stretch 30 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
hamstring_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 40m "Full body movement"
WARMUP
jumping_jack 20 reps
leg_swings 10 reps each leg
arm_circles 10 reps
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
lunge 3x6..8 each leg rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
inverted_row 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
dead_bug 3x8 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 45 seconds
spinal_twist 30 seconds each side
forward_fold 45 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
END WEEK
WEEK 2
